Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D!
 
Stand ready for the new and renewed features for the upcoming 1.4.2 version!
Check below for more details.
 
▣ Heroes Revamp
 
19 of your favorite Heroes are revamped for better performance in the battle

 

 
1. Captain America
-Normal attack motions are now more effective with attack range increased.
- "Valor" – Skill range increased
- "Ready for Battle" – Skill effect is now applied to all team members
 
2. Ironman
- Normal attack motions are now more effective, with the range increased.
- Dash motion enhanced; see how Ironman flies with style!
 ※Note: The changes above will not be applied to Ironman’s uniform – Secret Wars: 2099.
 
2-1. Uniform – Iron Man – Secret Wars: 2099
-  "Missile Barage" – Number of missiles increased to 20 (up from 16)
 
3. Ultron
-Normal Attack is changed. It is now slightly faster and more fluid than before for more effective skill combos.
- "Chest Beam" and "Robotic Slam" - Extended hit results
- "Encephalo-Ray" – Affects the area instead of hitting certain targets. Knock-back effect removed. 
- "Electronic Field"' - Slow motion effect is now activated quicker. Skill effect duration slightly extended.
 
4. Red Skull
- "Rapid Fire" – Skill motion speed increased. Projectiles now pierce multiple enemies. Back-stepping motion added after the finishing blow.
- "Fatal Blow" - Initial and finishing delay reduced. Effect duration slightly increased.
- "Strategist" - Skill motions are simplified for quicker impact.
- "Cosmic Cube Destruction" - Initial and finishing delay reduced. Effect duration slightly increased.
- "Rapid Fire", "Fatal Blow", "Cosmic Cube Destruction" - Damage slightly increased.
 
5. Dare Devil
- All skill motions are now faster with slightly increased range of effect.
- Movement Speed increased.
- "Club Swing" - Allows you to cancel before the finishing blow.
- "Billy Club Shot", "Staff Splash" - Damage slightly increased.
 
6. Mocking Bird
-All Skills and normal attacks are now faster.
- "Twin Stave Attack” - Skill range increased.
- "Bo-Staff Kick" - Skill range increased.
- "Concentration" - Initial and finishing delay reduced.
- "Bo-Staff Strike" - Skill range increased.
 
 
7. Winter Soldier
-Normal Attack range increased.
- "Suppressing Fire" - Initial and finishing delay reduced, while skill motion speed is increased.
- "Bionic Combat" - Effect duration increased. Finishing delay reduced.
- "Sensory Array" - Skill motion speed increased. Finishing delay reduced.
- "Sharpshooter" - Back-stepping motion added before starting the fire. Skill range and effect duration increased.
 
8. Spiderman
- "Web Fling". : The effect range now includes the enemy right in front of Spiderman.
 
9. Angela
- "Sword Blow" and "Avenging Angel" - Skill range increased.
 
10. Iron Fist
-Normal attacks now affect areas instead of certain targets
-"Chi of Flying Crane" - Knock-back effect newly added
- "Pressure Point Jab" - Skill range increased
- "The Iron Fist" - Skill cool down is reduced to 8 sec (down from 10)
 
11. Sharon Carter
- "Sliding Kick" - Skill range increased
- "Back Flip Attack" - Skill range increased
- "Backup" - Effective area is now changed to a circular shape with increased range
 
12. Black Bolt
- "Electron Channeling" - Skill range increased.
- "Power Word" - Skill range increased. Stun effect newly added.
 
13. Bullseye
- "Storm of Sword" - Skill range increased
 
14. Black Cat
- "Cat Scratch" - Cooldown reduced to 7 sec (down from 8)
- "Cat-Hunt" - Cooldown Time reduced to 8 sec (down from 9)
- "Acrobatic Kick" - Damage increased
 
15. Luke Cage
- "Screaming" - Skill effect is now applied to all team members
 
16. M.O.D.O.K.
- Projectile motion adjusted for better accuracy of normal attacks.
- "Dominance of Spirit" - Initial and finishing delay reduced.
- "Impending Doom" - Initial and finishing delay reduced. Effective duration increased.
- "Telekinetic Force Blast" - Finishing delay reduced.
 
17. Electra
- "Rain of Blood" - Projectiles now pierce through multiple enemies. Bleeding effect is newly added.
 
18. Loki
- "Energy Barrier" - Cooldown is reduced to 13 sec (down from 15)
 
19. Punisher
- "Grenade Throw", "Punish the Guilty" - Damage increased.
 
 
▣ Introducing New 6★ Skills for 7 Heroes
 
New 6★ Skills for Black Panther, Loki, Iron Fist, Winter Soldier, Sharon Carter, Kingpin, Venom are newly added
 
-Venom: Lethal Symbiosis
-Loki: Mind Games
-Iron Fist: Chi Strike
-Sharon Carter: Extreme Diversion
-Black Panther: Unseen Predator
-Winter Soldier: Explosive Sabotage
-Kingpin: Criminal Mastermind

 

 
 
 
▣ Multi Play Improvements
 
1. New Super Villains added for Multi Play
 
-Venom, Maestro Hulk, and Armor Wars Kingpin
 
2. Multi Play invitation to Alliance Members using Alliance Chat
 New function is added, which allows you to invite your alliance members to a private Multi-Play session.
 

 

 
You can invite using alliance button in private game by sending a link for your alliance member to join. Touch the button, and join the alliance Multi-Play.

 
- Touch the "Join" button, and enter the waiting room where your alliance members are waiting!
 
 
 
▣ Battle World Improvement
 
Top Percentage Rewards and Special Rank Rewards are newly added. Participation Reward is improved for more detailed and effective rewarding.


※ Note. Actual results of Rank Reward and Participation Reward may vary depending on each Battle World.
 
Daily entrance for Battle World is now limited.
Your entrance count will be refreshed every day at 15:00 UTC+0.



※ Number of Daily Limit may vary depending on each Battle World
 
 
▣ Dimension Rift Improvement
 
Energy Consumption on each attempt will no longer increase.
Check the following table for more details



 
▣ Other Improvements
 
1. Buy again buttons have been removed completely
2. In the Uniform menu, only the ones currently you own or are selling in shop will appear.
3. Prices in Item Shop in S.H.I.E.L.D. LAB now appear in button forms for better readability.
4. Using Crystals allow you to add up to 5 team slots.
 - Slot 4 : 100 Crystals
- Slot 5 : 200 Crystals
5. Warning message will pop up if you attempt to fuse a piece of an incomplete cover.
6. Villain Siege: Zombie Venom is replaced with Classic Venom.
 ※Attack Pattern remains unchanged
7. Achievement and Inventory Icon improved for better clarity.
8. Best Condition now appears in an icon form.
9. Resolved the issue with Venom's unintended Symbiotic Surge motion being repeated in certain cases.
10. Resolved the issue of Warmachine's skill "Missile Strafe" not shooting the last missile in certain cases
11. Maximum number of Honor and Chaos Tokens stacked in your possession will be limited to 60,000.
 ※ When you already have the maximum amount of tokens, you may not receive any more after completing Villain Siege or Timeline Battle.
12. Resolved the issue with Kingpin's Uniform unintendedly reducing Attack Stat.
    Resolved the issue with Kingpin’s Body Slam skill for Stun effect not applied.
13. Actual buff duration is properly implemented in Skill Preview.
14. Mission difficulty of 2-1 to 3-5 is lowered.
15. Resolved the issue with Malekith's skill "Extinguishing Darkness" not pulling enemies closer.
16. Some of First Clear rewards are improved.
 ※ If you already acquired the reward, you will not be rewarded twice.
17. Unintended ISO-8 effects or Cover effects reflected to arena opponents is removed.
18. New comers and Returning Agent Reward System Added (1 time per account).
19. Player characters appearing as enemies in Battle World and Timeline Battle will receive effects of ISO-8, ISO-8 set effects, Special Equips and Cover Effect.
